title: Hello
description: The first frame on the connection, in BOTH directions — one type name, two shapes, told apart by who received it. The plugin's carries the token and is refused without it; the companion's answers. A frame of any other type before hello closes the connection with hello_required.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

harness.description: The harness this plugin translates for, e.g. hermes.

token.description: 🔴 SECRET-CLASS. Read from $UFFICI_HOME/wire-token, compared in constant time, and NEVER logged by either side — not at any level, not in an error, not inside a whole-frame dump.

contextBudgetTokens.description: The harness's share of its window for platform content. The platform sizes to it with its own estimator; the companion never estimates.

agentSlug.description: Known from wave 1b; the fixture supplies a fixed value.
